title: Advisor Analysis report shows Customer, Date and Advisor filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the Advisor Analysis report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. The Advisor Analysis report shows three filter buttons: Customer, Date and Advisor.

2. The table shows columns including Date, Invoice, Customer, Advisor, Days Open, Lines, Hrs Worked, Hrs Invoiced, Hrs Profit, Billing Efficiency, ELR, Parts Cost, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin and Subtotal.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6 #6
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Option lists pending Branko's PRD.
